text: 11月8日上午，第九届中国国际进口博览会上海交易团大型零售采购商联盟集中采购签约仪式举行。上海市政府副秘书长、上海交易团副团长朱民指出，历经九载发展，进博会成交与首发成果丰硕，上海交易团意向成交额已连续八年居全国地方交易团第一，本届展会规模再创新高，而大型零售采购商联盟作为上海交易团重要组成部分，会员已从成立之初21家发展至45家，践行着“在上海、买全球、卖全球”。一批重点采购项目代表进行现场推介，聚焦进口优质消费品引进，充分释放进博会溢出效应。据不完全统计，本届进博会上零售联盟已达成72个采购意向。(澎湃新闻)
text_en: On the morning of November 8, the centralized procurement signing ceremony of the Large Retail Purchasers Alliance of the Shanghai Trading Delegation of the 9th China International Import Expo was held. Zhu Min, Deputy Secretary-General of the Shanghai Municipal Government and Deputy Head of the Shanghai Trading Delegation, noted that after nine years of development, the CIIE has produced fruitful transaction and debut results, and the Shanghai Trading Delegation's intended transaction volume has ranked first among all local trading delegations nationwide for eight consecutive years. The scale of this year's expo hit a new record high. As an important part of the Shanghai Trading Delegation, the Large Retail Purchasers Alliance has grown its membership from 21 at its establishment to 45, practicing the concept of "buying globally and selling globally in Shanghai." Representatives of a number of key procurement projects made on-site presentations, focusing on the introduction of high-quality imported consumer goods and fully unleashing the spillover effects of the CIIE. According to incomplete statistics, the Retail Alliance has reached 72 procurement intentions at this year's CIIE. (The Paper)
